description: Muninn memory engine hooks for the Codex plugin. Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it: Codex hooks are shell-form and match Codex tool names (apply_patch). On Windows Codex hands `commandWindows` to the session's shell, PowerShell unless the session has none and cmd.exe then, and neither is sh: every line there is `cmd --% /c "…"`, which PowerShell passes on as it stands and cmd.exe unwraps, so one spelling runs in both. SessionStart there runs the binary itself, after scripts/session-start.ps1 in PowerShell has downloaded it when it is not there yet. Codex substitutes ${PLUGIN_ROOT} before the shell sees the command. SessionStart goes through scripts/session-start, which downloads the binary for this plugin version the first time and then execs it. `the_codex_plugin_hooks_match_the_generator` fails if this file drifts from `muninn init --codex`.

hooks.commandWindows: cmd --% /c "(if not exist "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\muninn.exe" powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\scripts\session-start.ps1" <NUL) && "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\muninn.exe" hook SessionStart || exit /b 0"
